title: Windows toast status read through WRL, not C++/WinRT
context: The runner builds with Flutter's apply_standard_settings: /W4 /WX and _HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0. C++/WinRT needs exceptions, and its hresult_error catch would not compile. Builders cannot compile Windows code on the Mac, so the first compile is the PR CI.
options: WRL ABI: RoGetActivationFactory, IToastNotificationManagerStatics::CreateToastNotifierWithId, IToastNotifier::get_Setting, linking runtimeobject.lib
Read the HKCU Notifications\Settings registry value
outcome: WRL ABI: it compiles under the template's flags with no exception handling and uses the documented API instead of a registry layout. Every runner and bridge task now carries the build-flag rule (no try/catch/throw, check every HRESULT, ComPtr).
